messages.subject: Spatio-Temporal Model - preparing the data
parts:
Hello,

I have data for around ~2500 regions for which I have the population size, and I have another file of observations per region per date.
When fitting a spatial INLA model, I just computed the ~2500 expected values (shape_02$expected) and passes the vector of observed values (shape_02$patients_total).

ID = 1:2644
formula_bym = shape_02$patients_total ~ 1 + f(ID, model="bym", graph = "neighbours.adj", constr=TRUE, scale.model=TRUE)
m05_inla_bym = inla(formula_bym, family="poisson", data=as.data.frame(shape_02), E=shape_02$expected, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))


However, if I want to go temporal, I'm not really sure how should I compute the observed and the expected, as suddenly the amount of needed observations is, per every region, a vector of all the time periods (I have ~10 years and would like to fit a montlhy/quarterly model).

Can somebody help me understand how should I pre-process the data to tackle such task?

Thanks,
Alan

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Spatio-Temporal Model - preparing the data
parts:
On Mon, 2017-06-19 at 08:18 -0700, Alan Arazi wrote:
> Hello,

>
>
> However, if I want to go temporal, I'm not really sure how should I
> compute the observed and the expected, as suddenly the amount of
> needed observations is, per every region, a vector of all the time
> periods (I have ~10 years and would like to fit a montlhy/quarterly
> model).
>

Hi

In this case you need to go 2-dimensional in your indexing, like

f(region, model="bym", group=time)


where time is 1, 2, 3, ... (and NOT the raw-year!)

its natural to start with control.group = list(model="ar1")


it means that you can format your data in this order

> region=1:5
> time=1:4
> cbind(rep(region, length(time)), rep(time, each = length(region)))
      [,1] [,2]
 [1,]    1    1
 [2,]    2    1
 [3,]    3    1
 [4,]    4    1
 [5,]    5    1
 [6,]    1    2
 [7,]    2    2
 [8,]    3    2
 [9,]    4    2
[10,]    5    2
[11,]    1    3
[12,]    2    3
[13,]    3    3
[14,]    4    3
[15,]    5    3
[16,]    1    4
[17,]    2    4
[18,]    3    4
[19,]    4    4
[20,]    5    4


or any other order.



hope this helps

Best
H
